title: CompatibilityTestCase
description: A test case for the Hypen engine compatibility test suite

name.description: Unique identifier for the test case (kebab-case)

description.description: Human-readable description of what this test verifies

priority.description: Test priority (P0 = critical, P1 = important, P2 = nice-to-have)

source.description: Hypen DSL source code to render

actions.description: List of action names this module handles

patchCount.description: Expected number of patches (alternative to exact match)

patchTypes.description: Expected patch types in exact emission order

strictPatchOrder.description: When true, `patches` must match the emitted patches index-by-index (exact emission order) instead of structurally. Use for fixtures whose contract IS the ordering, e.g. the flagged-root-first deferred-remove protocol

source.description: Replacement Hypen DSL source (for renderSource action) — reconciled against the existing tree, so subtree replacement/teardown paths can be exercised

stateChange.description: State change to apply (for updateState action)

animation.description: Optional batch-animation context for this step's state update (Option D transaction-scoped animation) — applies to updateState steps and to the state update a dispatchAction step's handler produces. Either a spec object (e.g. {"curve": "spring"}; a missing duration is filled with 250 engine-side) or a bare curve string ("linear"|"easeIn"|"easeOut"|"easeInOut"|"spring", normalized to {curve, duration: 250}). When the update changes state and emits patches, the engine prepends a batchAnimation patch as the batch's first entry.

expectedPatchCount.description: Expected number of patches (alternative to exact match)

expectedPatchTypes.description: Expected patch types in exact emission order

strictPatchOrder.description: When true, `expectedPatches` must match the emitted patches index-by-index (exact emission order) instead of structurally. Use for steps whose contract IS the ordering, e.g. the flagged-root-first deferred-remove protocol

forbiddenPatchTypes.description: Patch types that must NOT appear in this step's emitted patches (e.g. ["create", "remove"] to pin that an update reconciles in place)

forbiddenPatches.description: Patch types that must NOT appear

sdks.description: SDKs to skip this test for (e.g., ['golang'] if not yet implemented)
